info.title: Automiqo Lead Service
info.description: Managed lead generation — operator API + client CRM

get.description:
Readiness: verifies the dependencies the app cannot serve traffic without.
Returns 503 when not ready, so load balancers hold traffic back.

post.description:
Start pipeline in background so the HTTP request never times out.
Returns run_id immediately; poll GET /admin/runs for progress.
Pass ?sync=1 to wait for completion (dev only).
Upload CRM export rows so pipeline never resells existing customers.
One removal — never surface this business to any tenant.
Re-check phone/email; auto-credit if dead.
Attach Stripe customer / subscription item to tenant.
Push net usage_log leads_delivered to Stripe for one tenant.
Cron: report all tenants with Stripe IDs.

get.description: Per-run lead board: cards grouped by stage/tier for operator review.

patch.description: Drag-drop update: change tier/stage/included; optionally sync lead_assignments.

get.description: Operator view: leads assigned to a client (or summary by client if no tenant_id).
CSV for Instantly/Smartlead sequences — Apollo sequence alternative.

patch.description: Client or operator updates scoring weight overrides on an ICP.

get.description: Which vertical+geo+offer combos are locked by exclusive ICPs.

One-screen churn-risk view: usage + last activity + pipeline success per tenant.
Surfaces tenants who haven't touched the product in 2+ weeks.

post.description: Manually trigger proactive alert checks (also intended for cron/n8n).

get.description: Inspect effective feature flags (global + optional tenant).

Resolve the logged-in user's tenant from their verified JWT alone
(no tenant_id in this path, so require_tenant falls back to their
first active membership). Frontend calls this once after login to
learn which tenant_id to use for every other /crm/{tenant_id}/... call
— it never lets the browser pick or enumerate tenants itself.
KPIs + funnel + recent activity for the home screen.
Paginated, filterable lead list for the CRM table view.
Full lead card + timeline + tasks + score transparency (why this lead).

post.description: Move lead to a pipeline stage + log activity.

get.description: All stages with leads nested — for Kanban UI.
Conversion, tier mix, delivery stats for Reports page.
Return lead rows as JSON (frontend turns into CSV download).

post.description: Seed default pipeline stages for a new tenant portal.

Client reports dead/wrong lead — opens ops ticket and applies SLA credit
immediately (idempotent). Response always includes a clear credit status
so the UI can show "Credited: 1 lead" instead of a silent backend action.

get.description: Public to tenant portal — white-label CSS vars. No operator key.

patch.description: Tenant admin updates their own brand. Secured layer enforces JWT.

post.description:
Manual one-shot first touch — user toggles send in CRM.
Not fired automatically on pipeline assign.
Send one custom email to a lead (Resend or SMTP).
Send custom email to selected leads, or all matching filters (Send all).
Type ICP → run pipeline → return lead cards for the web Search tab.

Get a free sample of high-quality leads for a vertical+geo.
Does not consume exclusivity or billing quota — sales demo tool.

get.description:
Which vertical+geo+offer_category combos are locked by exclusive ICPs.
Useful during sales calls: "Newark's taken, Jersey City's open."

Remaining on-demand search-runs for the current billing period.
Counts pipeline_runs this month (search-run creates a pipeline run).

post.description:
Accept invite by token. auth_user_id comes from the verified JWT
(require_auth_only), never from the request body — a client-supplied
user id here would let anyone bind someone else's invite to their own
account.

Unauthenticated sample pack for marketing / 'get 10 free leads' landing page.
Capped harder than the authenticated version.

get.description: Deal pipeline stages for this tenant, in board order.

post.description:
Move a deal to a stage. Mirrors the stage's probability / won-lost status
onto the deal and records a 'stage_change' activity with from/to.

get.description:
Everything that happened on this account: activities attached to the
company itself plus those on its contacts and deals, newest first.

post.description:
Promote an assigned lead into the CRM: company + contact + deal.

Provenance: companies.source_lead_id = the leads_global id,
deals.source_assignment_id = the assignment id.

Idempotent — if a company already exists for that source_lead_id in this
tenant, it is returned (with any missing contact/deal filled in) rather
than creating a duplicate account.

target_new_leads.description: Net-new leads target; use 5000–15000 for statewide ICPs
